So this stat looks crazy :

With Bumrah: 21 wins in 29 Tests - 72.4% win rate
Without Bumrah: 22 wins in 52 Tests - 42.3% win rate

But there’s a huge catch.

Bumrah has played 52 Tests, and 44 of those came against SENA teams (Australia, England, New Zealand and South Africa)

That means 84.6% of Bumrah’s Tests have come against SENA opposition.

So comparing the two win rates directly is misleading. Bumrah has spent most of his career playing India’s toughest opponents,
